childrensPrivacy.content: Homework Supply is designed for educational use and may be used by students under 13 with parental or school consent. We comply with COPPA requirements and do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent. Schools and instructors are responsible for obtaining necessary parental consent.
childrensPrivacy.heading: Children's Privacy

contactUs.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact your instructor or the platform administrator. For general inquiries, you can reach us through the support channels available in the platform.
contactUs.heading: Contact Us

cookies.content: We use essential cookies and local storage for authentication, session management, and offline functionality. We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising cookies. Local storage is used to cache learning content for offline access.
cookies.heading: Cookies & Local Storage

dataSharing.aiProcessingText: Audio and text content is sent to OpenAI for transcription, feedback, and assessment. OpenAI does not use this data for training.
dataSharing.classmatesText: Leaderboard rankings and squad activity may be visible to other students in your section (you can opt out).
dataSharing.heading: Data Sharing
dataSharing.instructorsText: Your instructors can view your submissions, grades, and learning progress within their sections.
dataSharing.intro: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data in the following limited circumstances:
dataSharing.legalText: We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the safety of our users.

dataStorage.heading: Data Storage & Security
dataStorage.intro: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard practices:
dataStorage.item1: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL) and at rest using AWS encryption services
dataStorage.item2: Files are stored in Amazon S3 with access controls based on your role and ownership
dataStorage.item3: Database records are managed through AWS DynamoDB with fine-grained access control
dataStorage.outro: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide services. You may request deletion of your data at any time.

howWeUseInfo.heading: How We Use Your Information
howWeUseInfo.intro: We use your information for the following purposes:
howWeUseInfo.item1: Providing personalized learning experiences and AI-powered tutoring
howWeUseInfo.item2: Tracking academic progress and generating performance reports for instructors
howWeUseInfo.item3: Processing audio and text through AI services (OpenAI) for feedback and assessment
howWeUseInfo.item4: Enabling real-time collaboration features between students and instructors
howWeUseInfo.item5: Improving platform features, fixing bugs, and enhancing educational outcomes

informationWeCollect.accountInfoText: Email address, display name, and authentication credentials when you create an account.
informationWeCollect.heading: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.intro: We collect the following types of information to provide and improve our educational services:
informationWeCollect.learningDataText: Assignment submissions, grades, progress tracking, XP earned, and learning analytics.
informationWeCollect.usageInfoText: Device information, browser type, pages visited, and interaction patterns to improve the platform experience.
informationWeCollect.userContentText: Audio recordings, text responses, uploaded files, and chat messages created during learning activities.

introduction.content: Welcome to Homework Supply. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and share your information when you use our educational platform.
introduction.heading: Introduction

policyChanges.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify users of significant changes through the platform. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
policyChanges.heading: Changes to This Policy

yourRights.heading: Your Rights
yourRights.intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
yourRights.item1: Access: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
yourRights.item2: Correction: Update or correct inaccurate personal information
yourRights.item3: Deletion: Request deletion of your account and associated data
yourRights.item4: Export: Download your learning data in a portable format
yourRights.item5: Opt-out: Disable leaderboard visibility and certain data sharing features
yourRights.outro: To exercise these rights, contact your instructor or reach out to us using the contact information below.
